options_auto_skip_sponsors_intros_outros.message: Auto-skip sponsors, intros, outros, self-promo, and interaction reminders

options_custom_filters_intro.message: Your own element-hiding rules, one per line. The popup's element picker writes here. Format: example.com##.selector — one hostname, then ##, then a CSS selector.

options_every_site_where_you_changed_som.message: Every site where you changed something, in one place. Repair steps keep ad blocking on and only switch off the part that broke the page; allowlisted sites get no blocking at all.

options_export_your_lists_site_rules_and.message: Export your lists, site rules and preferences as a file, or restore them on another machine. Purchases are not included — restore those with the email from your receipt.

options_force_on_or_off_for_specific_hos.message: Force on or off for specific hostnames. Clear an entry to follow the global toggle.

options_hide_shorts_entry_points_and_red.message: Hide Shorts entry points and redirect Shorts URLs

options_license_buy_hint.message: Buy opens ExtensionPay / Stripe ($$2 one-time). Already paid? Restore with the email from your receipt. Ad blocking stays free either way.

options_license_local_cache_hint.message: Using a local license cache (ExtensionPay id missing in this build).

options_license_refresh_hint.message: License refreshes from ExtensionPay when online. Offline grace lasts up to 14 days.

options_license_unavailable_hint.message: Purchases unavailable in this build — update StampStack from the Chrome Web Store.

options_license_unpacked_hint.message: ExtensionPay not configured in this build. Unpacked: use Dev unlock to test dark mode.

options_list_age_aging.message: Filter lists refreshed $WHEN$ ($DATE$) — a StampStack update will refresh them soon.

options_list_age_stale.message: Filter lists refreshed $WHEN$ ($DATE$) — behind upstream. A new StampStack version will refresh them.

options_list_age_unknown.message: Filter list date unavailable for this build.

options_list_not_active.message: Not active — Chrome's shared rule limit is full. $COUNT$ network rules are not loaded; element hiding for this list still works.

options_list_rule_count.message: $COUNT$ network rules · cosmetics follow this toggle

options_manifest_v3_ad_amp_tracker_block.message: Manifest V3 ad & tracker blocker · uBO-parity within the rules

options_no_filter_lists.message: No filter lists available. Reinstall StampStack or contact support.

options_optional_one_time_unlock_that_da.message: Optional one-time unlock that darkens ordinary web pages (smart invert). Surfaces that are already dark are left alone rather than inverted into light. Independent of pause and the site allowlist — ad blocking stays free. Reinstalling? Use Restore purchase with the email from your ExtensionPay / Stripe receipt.

options_paid_sponsored_feed_tiles_and_in.message: Paid / “Sponsored” feed tiles and in-player ad UI

options_sponsor_all_categories_off.message: Every category is off — StampStack will not contact the SponsorBlock API.

options_sponsor_cat_intro_hint.message: Title cards and animated intros with no content.

options_sponsor_cat_music_offtopic_hint.message: Non-music parts of a music video.

options_sponsor_cat_outro_hint.message: Credits and endcards after the content ends.

options_sponsor_cat_preview_hint.message: Recaps of this video, or of a previous one.

options_sponsor_cat_selfpromo_hint.message: Unpaid plugs for the creator’s own merch or Patreon.

options_sponsor_cat_sponsor_hint.message: Paid promotion, paid referrals, direct advertising.

options_toggle_lists_on_or_off_this_enab.message: Toggle lists on or off. This enables or disables each list’s network rules, cosmetics, and scriptlets together. List contents ship with the extension; updates arrive with new StampStack versions.

options_youtube_intro.message: Extra controls for YouTube. Promoted-video hiding removes paid feed tiles and scrubs player ad payloads. Shorts blocking hides Shorts shelves and leaves /shorts/ pages. SponsorBlock skips mid-video sponsor segments using the community database at sponsor.ajay.app.
